# HTML and semantic tagging

> **这页管什么**：元素按语义用，不按外观用。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/semantic-tagging> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

1. **Use elements for their intended purpose.** Mark titles of standalone works with `cite`.
2. **Fall back to CSS or non-semantic elements** when no semantically relevant HTML element exists.
3. **Don't use tables or frames for page layout** — use CSS.
4. **Reserve heading elements for actual hierarchy**, not visual text styling.
5. **`em` signals true emphasis**, not italics generally — use `i` for non-emphatic italics.
6. **`strong` conveys strong importance**, not bold alone — use `b` for bolding without that importance.
7. **`br` is only for line breaks intrinsic to the content**, as in poems or addresses — not for spacing. Use `p` with CSS.
